status: EXPLORATORY pilot P1 of docs/13 amendment A5, arm (ii), seed 100: the frozen gates of the arm (i) run (TM, LR, LR2, HGB, C0 and the two TM ablations, each with its per-bucket read-out fitted on H' residue 2a) scored on the BLiMP dev half (A4 H9.4 split, docs/notes/preregistration-data-hashes-A4-blimp.json). Supports no claim. Validation and test are NOT used.
docs: docs/13 A5 (P1 arm ii, GO / NO-GO / grey), A4 H9.4; model src/tmlm/cvtm/crtm.py
base: the frozen CVTM-core of the cache run (KN-5 on all training documents, CPU backend); each sentence is one document; per position the core's top-64, P_S top-64 (KN on all documents), k*, bucket and document features come from the frozen core (the validation-group semantics of the cache)
scoring: sentence log-probability = sum over its tokens of ln P (core, or core tilted by the gate with the arm (i) read-out); a pair is correct when the good sentence has the strictly larger log-probability; accuracy in points
statistics: paired bootstrap over the dev pairs, 2,000 resamples (SeedSequence([20260924, 0xB1, 1])), percentile 95 percent interval
verdict_arm_ii: GO(ii): TM minus core >= 2.0 points with the CI excluding 0 AND TM minus the best control >= 1.0 point; best control = the highest dev accuracy among {LR, LR2, HGB} (conservative; the control chosen on 2a in arm (i) is reported too). NO-GO part: TM minus core < 1.0 point or TM minus the best control < 0
verdict_P1: GO if arm (i) or arm (ii) is GO; NO-GO if both arms meet their NO-GO condition; grey otherwise (crtm.verdict_p1)
